what: Bound stock Victor, Bruce and Ada to independent Live Link Hub subjects in the station editor. Added a clock-synchronized Quest 2 publisher for a second XR editor.
why: Both headsets can animate distinct people while the webcam supplies a full-body third pose. The remote XR sampler uses the same open headset session as the wearer’s Unreal view.
details: All three dressed stock characters moved from Hub frames in the editor and in Simulate. A fixed Creator preview driver survived both custom-depth component re-registrations. A physical webcam run published 222 full-body samples; live mesh readings showed hand and foot motion relative to Bruce’s pelvis. The Quest 2 sampler returned 301 timestamped samples on the station Mac but no physical hand or head movement in that interval. The second Mac still needs headset motion verification.
